messages:
Mia: Customer reported parser failures when using structured/json mode — their consumer gets invalid/mangled JSON.
Mia: From their logs (raw response we sent):
```json
{"result":"{\"message\":\"User said: \\\"hello\\\"\\nNewline here\\uD83D\"}"}
```
Ashok: Looks like double-encoding — our response has a stringified JSON in `result` instead of an object.
Jules: I see a canary deploy touch on structured-postproc earlier: structured-postproc v1.2.3 -> 1.2.4 at 1834567802
deploy-bot: deploy structured-postproc v1.2.4 to canary @1834567802
Ingrid: Mia, can you share request_id + whether they used streaming? Also SDK version?
Mia: request_id=rc_0a7e9c, streaming=true, sdk=0.9.2
Ashok: Streaming + our new postproc = bug: we escaped quotes early and emitted chunks that split escape sequences (\uXXXX / UTF-8 surrogates), client sees truncated escape -> JSON parser error.
Ashok: Short repro (non-prod):
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-rl","mode":"structured","stream":true,"input":"say \"hi\" and include emoji"}'
```
Jules: Rolling back postproc to v1.2.3 on prod, will push hotfix that buffers escapes across chunks.
deploy-bot: rollback structured-postproc -> v1.2.3 started @1834567913
deploy-bot: rollback finished @1834567917
Mia: Customer retested, parser now accepts response. They reported fixed. :tada:
Ingrid: We'll add regression test for streaming+structured that includes surrogate pairs and split-escape cases.
Mia: Closing the escalation after customer ack. Thanks all.
